description: Search I14Y, the Swiss federal interoperability platform: datasets (incl. non-public registers, with their access rights), data services/APIs, public services and concepts/code lists from federal, cantonal and municipal bodies. Use it to find which authority holds what data, or the identifier of an official code list. Example: {query: 'NOGA', types: ['Concept']}, {query: 'Gebäude', types: ['Dataset']}.

types.description: Restrict to Dataset, DataService, Concept (incl. code lists), PublicService, MappingTable

name: search_federal_metadata
title: Search the federal data catalogue (I14Y)
